exposure.needed: whether any custom setup in the environment (selectors, monitors, alerts, tooling) references the removed statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label

consequence.statement: Custom setups that select or match pods and external listener Services via the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label stop matching, because that label is no longer present; they must use strimzi.io/pod-name instead.
consequence.remediation: Update any custom setup leveraging the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label to use the strimzi.io/pod-name label instead.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label from pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services; custom setups leveraging that label should use the `strimzi.io/pod-name` label instead.
